description: Create a public (shareable, time-limited) download URL for a build artifact by its secure filename. Codemagic REST: POST /artifacts/{secureFilename}/public-url.

expiresAt.description: When the public URL should expire, as a UNIX timestamp in SECONDS.

secureFilename.description: The secure filename/path of the artifact (from a build's artifacts list).

name: codemagic_create_artifact_public_url
title: Create artifact public URL
